thread:
Maya (CS): Day0 kickoff for Nimbus private deployment. Quick readout of blockers: firewall egress rules, service account IAM for model pull, KMS key policy needs customer ACL, and audit log ingestion to Splunk not yet validated. @Arjun can you own the SA/IAM changes? :wave:
Arjun (Eng-Infra): On it. Can you paste the exact SA name and project?
Maya (CS): They’ll create `nimbus-redwood-sa` in project `nimbus-prod`. Needs roles: `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser` and `roles/storage.objectViewer` for model bucket. Also need to sync on KMS rotation with @Priya.
Priya (Security): Security note — KMS key must grant `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` to the Redwood service account and have an audit-only reader for the customer ops team. Send me the key resource name and a policy snippet.
Maya (CS): Key resource: `projects/nimbus-prod/locations/global/keyRings/nimbus-kr/cryptoKeys/rw-key-1`. Proposed snippet:
```json
{"bindings":[{"role":"roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter","members":["serviceAccount:nimbus-redwood-sa@nimbus-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]},{"role":"roles/cloudkms.viewer","members":["group:nimbus-ops@nimbus.example.com"]}]}
```
Arjun (Eng-Infra): LGTM, I’ll apply the binding after Alex confirms SA exists and post the IAM change here.
infra-bot: Runbook created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/nimbus-week0 — firewall egress ranges we need whitelisted: `35.196.0.0/14`, `34.120.0.0/14`. Use ports `443` and `10250` for healthchecks/metrics.
Alex (Nimbus): Thanks — I’ll ask infra to create the SA and confirm KMS ACLs. For audit logs we’re sending to Splunk at `https://splunk.nimbus.example/ingest` — do you require a CSR or can you accept a customer-provided cert (self-signed)?
Ben (SRE): We prefer mutual TLS for Splunk ingestion. Alex please upload the CSR to the handoff doc or attach certs. Certs accepted if TLS 1.2+ and you provide rotation schedule. @Priya can you confirm retention requirement?
Priya (Security): Retention per contract: 365 days for audit logs. mTLS is fine. Also we need an integrity proof (e.g., HMAC header or signed entries) — will send acceptance criteria in the runbook.
Maya (CS): Next steps summary: 1) Arjun apply IAM bindings once SA exists; 2) Priya finalize and sign off KMS key policy; 3) Ben coordinate Splunk mTLS and ingestion schema; 4) Alex to provision SA + KMS ACLs and confirm by EOD. Any blockers? :thumbsup:
Alex (Nimbus): :thumbsup: aiming for EOD PST. Quick Q — what event proto do you prefer for audit logs? We’ll be sending JSON events.
Ben (SRE): JSON events are fine. Please send a small sample payload to `#support-telemetry` DM or attach here so we can validate mapping.
Maya (CS): Perfect — I’ll update the runbook with these action owners and ETA. Thanks all — will follow up once IAM/KMS confirmed. —Maya
